snippet.title: Pawsweeper Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: The shelter is full of cats, and the cats are full of parasites. Clear the fur in a puzzle in the spirit of Saper, only instead of cages there are circles, and instead of mines there are ticks and fleas. Spend the money you earn on treatment and upgrades, and get the shelter through one more day.
